ISLAM MAKHACHEV DEFENDS USMAN NURMAGOMEDOV AFTER MERAB DVALISHVILI WAS JUMPED IN ABU DHABI 😳🚨 A statement shared on Islam Makhachev’s Instagram story is now defending Usman Nurmagomedov and his team following the violent altercation involving Merab Dvalishvili. The statement claims Merab started the conflict months earlier when he slapped a Dagestani wrestler in Georgia and allegedly insulted his mother. But here’s my issue with that argument. Even if Merab was wrong for slapping someone, how does that justify multiple grown men attacking him and his friend months later? Two wrongs don’t make a right. Holding someone accountable for their actions is one thing. Defending a group attack is something completely different. I also raised questions about whether Islam personally wrote and published the statement or whether his manager, Ali Abdelaziz, was involved. That hasn’t been independently confirmed. Merab Dvalishvili, Usman Nurmagomedov, Umar Nurmagomedov, and now Islam Makhachev are all being drawn into one of the most heated controversies in MMA. Do you agree with the statement shared on Islam’s account, or is this a terrible justification for what happened to Merab? #merabdvalishvili #ufc #mma #usmannurmagomedov #islammakhachev
